numeric_output_trigger.event: Registered NEN_CHANGED notification, not only an explicit user edit or accepted-dialog copy-back.
numeric_output_trigger.message_identity: 0x1400039c0 and0x1400051f0 register the identical complete NEN_CHANGED name into different module globals. Under normal Windows registered-message semantics these represent the same message ID. The frozen message-map entry binds it to0x1400e6460.
numeric_output_trigger.programmatic_sender: 0x1402cb0a0 updates a numeric control when the requested value differs from control+0xf0. Under its drag/style notification condition it sends the registered message synchronously to its parent, with control ID and bounded scalar. Its recursion guard0x1419ac820 is distinct from renderer guard0x1419ac494 and handler guard0x1419ac498.
numeric_output_trigger.renderer_caller: For a selected tag6 mood with numeric capability projection,0x1400e4d60 caps the displayed payload at100 and calls0x1402cb0a0 for numeric controls. A programmatic refresh can therefore reach the same numeric write handler when notification and selected-scene guards permit.
numeric_output_trigger.write: 0x1400e6460 maps controlID minus0x2ea4 to the output, requires a selected existing scene/in-range vector slot, and replaces that slot's low payload with a0..100 scalar while retaining the high nibble.
numeric_output_trigger.boundary: This identifies a sufficient source-backed refresh/notification trigger for an unedited numeric output. No callback trace was retained for the historical case, so its unique originating event is not asserted.

HCL_trigger.entry: Lighting dialog initialization0x1400e1da0 calls HCL UI setup0x1400ed2b0 before the modal result, not only on OK.
HCL_trigger.original_model_alias: Setup reads owner+0x22e0, the HCL record pointer, and calls0x1405c49b0 on the owner. It does not first copy that HCL record into the temporary mood collection.
HCL_trigger.type_temperature_refresh: With an existing HCL record,0x1405c49b0 obtains current/default values from owner virtual+0x4b0 indices0x30 and0x2f, bounds them to2000..13000 and calls0x1405c48f0 with type4 and the existing mode. That setter writes type, mode and temperature members, applies its time-default rules, then calls0x1400e0340.
HCL_trigger.time_fill: After that refresh, setup has another conditional write: if FROM is still0 and mode is not1, it fills FROM/TO from cached values refreshed through0x1406a33b0, choosing one of two pairs by mode.
HCL_trigger.XML_binding: 0x1405d1580 binds that same owner+0x22e0 record to HCL: offsets0/4/8/12/16/20 are T/M/TMIN/TMAX/FROM/TO respectively. These are original persisted-model changes, not immediate disk writes.
HCL_trigger.boundary: The setup/caller/conditions are identified. Exact per-instance temperature provenance and the time adjustment/cache results, including the contribution of0x1400e0340, are not simulated or used to predict the historical numeric values.

delivery_decision.investigation: Stop at these triggers and precise remaining dependencies. No new extraction, live callback instrumentation, generic automation or additional native batch.
delivery_decision.CLI: Do not reproduce any output clamp, HCL refresh or time defaulting. Neither inspection nor selected numeric editing normalizes unrelated values.
delivery_decision.inspection_feature: Independent delivery: expose the previously recovered per-mood numeric/color editor classification. Keep set-mood-color a raw packed-value operation, not a mode-aware equivalent.
delivery_decision.historical_evidence: numeric-edit-save-reopen-20261111.json remains unchanged. Its eight observed attribute deltas are not retroactively upgraded to uniquely traced callbacks.
